## Natural history notes

A small meshweb spider characterized by a compact body, slender legs, and muted gray-brown to tan coloration that helps it blend against bark, leaves, and plant stems. In Florida, Emblyna florens has been recorded from sites including South Florida and is associated with vegetation in warm gardens, groves, forest edges, and other semi-wooded habitats. Like other dictynid meshweb spiders, it builds small irregular cribellate silk webs on plants or sheltered surfaces and feeds on tiny insects and other arthropods that become caught in the web.
